reason: The Vita assistant provided only partial diagnostic data (tire pressures and battery SoC) after repeated requests, but failed to deliver battery pack temperature, maintenance alerts, or dashboard warning lights despite explicit, direct questioning. The assistant repeatedly returned irrelevant climate control information and showed significant communication breakdown, cycling through the same generic responses without addressing the user's specific technical needs.
clarifyingNotes: The assistant eventually provided tire pressure readings (front left 2.4 bar, front right 2.4 bar, rear left 2.3 bar, rear right 2.4 bar) and confirmed 78% battery SoC. However, it explicitly stated lack of access to full diagnostic reports and maintenance alerts. Critical information gaps: (1) battery pack temperature was never provided despite three separate requests; (2) dashboard warning lights status remained unanswered; (3) maintenance schedule information was unavailable; (4) no safety advisory was offered regarding the rear left tire pressure being slightly lower than other wheels; (5) no range adequacy assessment was provided for the stated longer drive. The assistant's repeated failures to stay on-topic and inability to access or relay complete diagnostic data significantly undermined the utility of the interaction for a driver conducting pre-departure safety checks.
